name: cwenti
description: Cwenti reúne Clax, Kaikei y Noman en un launcher local impulsado por Codex App Server.

scripts.pack: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:win:portable: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.release:mac:arm64: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish always --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.release:win: npm run verify && npm run stage:apps && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish always --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run validate:registry
